applicabilityBasis.summary: BUIDL digitally represents non-voting participating Class A shares in BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd., a BVI professional investment fund, with NAV-based USD redemptions and private-investor eligibility requirements. The issuer/distributor-authored disclosure establishes securities/shareholder rights. GENIUS section 2(22)(B)(iii) excludes securities from payment stablecoin even when shares target a one-dollar NAV or can be exchanged for USDC.
